messages.author: e7a71d967e60bb41
messages.subject: Troubles with geom_vline
parts:
Dear All,
I am having some troubles in adding vertical lines to my plots.
Please see the snippet at the end of the email.
When I run the snippet (add a vertical line to a histogram) this is what
I get

Error in eval(expr, envir, enclos) : object 'count' not found

Why is that? I do not have a clue at what is going on.
I am running Ubuntu 9.10, 64-bit architecture and installed ggplot2
0.8.6 from CRAN.
Any help is appreciated.
Cheers

Lorenzo

###########################################

library(ggplot2)
library(Cairo)


set.seed(1234)
x <- (1-runif(10000))^(-1.5)
x <- x[which(x<=1e5)]
xf <- as.data.frame(x)
names(xf) <- "mydata"

ratio_min <- length(which(x<=1e5 & x>= 104.5))/length(x)
ratio_max <- length(which(x<=100.5 & x>= 100))/length(x)

gpl <- ggplot(xf,aes(x=mydata,y=..count..))+
geom_vline(xintercept = log10(3600))+
geom_histogram(binwidth=0.5, colour="darkgreen", fill="white")+
scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", limits=c(1,10000))+
xlab("Contact Duration (sec)")+
ylab("Pairwise Number of Contacts")+
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 20))+
opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size = 20, angle=90))+
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray",vjust=1))+
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray", hjust=1))


CairoPDF("my_data_bin_plot.pdf")
print(gpl)
dev.off()

################################################

messages.author: 45a85351148578ad
messages.subject: Re: Troubles with geom_vline
parts:
Hi Lorenzo,

I think the problem is that the y aesthetic should be mapped explicitly within geom_histogram:

gpl <- ggplot(xf,aes(x=mydata))+
geom_histogram(aes(y = ..count..), binwidth=0.5, colour="darkgreen", fill="white")+
 geom_vline(xintercept = log10(3600))+

scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", limits=c(1,10000))+
xlab("Contact Duration (sec)")+
ylab("Pairwise Number of Contacts")+
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 20))+
opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size = 20, angle=90))+
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray",vjust=1))+
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray", hjust=1))

hope this helps,
fernando

2010/3/4 Lorenzo Isella <lorenzo...@gmail.com>

messages.author: d588a03e58ea7e7f
messages.subject: Re: Troubles with geom_vline
parts:
Fernando has a good workaround for this.

I was trying to figure out why it was a problem. geom_vline has
ignore.aes=TRUE, so it should not care about the y=..count.. aes in
the original call. However, in map_statistic (layer.r, line 183), it
looks for any computed aesthetic (which ..count.. is) in the data
(looks for a variable without the dots; the error follows from the
call in line 193). Should this function have some checks involving
inherits.aes like layer_mapping does? I'm not sure exactly how or
where, but that seems to be where the problem is really coming from.

--Brian Diggs
